note: Availability/missingness only. No outcome is computed.

atr_percentile.required_formula: percentile rank of ATR0 among same-bucket historical ATR values. BUCKET = the completed 5-minute bucket-of-CME-trade-day containing t0. REFERENCE = the Wilder ATR(14) value at that SAME 5m bucket on each of the preceding 252 eligible trade dates carrying a valid observation for it. Not end-of-day ATR, not a neighbouring bucket, never a future date.
atr_percentile.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0

close_vs_level_atr.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0

competing_liquidity_atr.required_formula: min over all OTHER available levels of |other.price - level| / ATR_at_sweep; SAME SIDE only
competing_liquidity_atr.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0
competing_liquidity_atr.missingness_rule: cap (10.0) when no other same-side level exists

dist_overnight_high_atr.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0

dist_overnight_low_atr.required_formula: (close - min low over [18:00 ET, 09:30 ET) of this trade day) / ATR
dist_overnight_low_atr.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0

dist_session_open_atr.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0

dist_weekly_open_atr.required_formula: (close - open of the first bar of the CME trade week, week starting with the Sunday 18:00 ET open) / ATR
dist_weekly_open_atr.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0

htf_15m_compression.required_formula: (mean TR of last 4 CLOSED 15m bars)/(mean TR of last 16 CLOSED 15m bars)
htf_15m_compression.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0

htf_1h_dist_ref_atr.required_formula: (close_of_last_CLOSED_1H_bar - REFERENCE) / ATR_1H, where REFERENCE is EXACTLY the open of the current CME trade day's first 1H bar
htf_1h_dist_ref_atr.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0

htf_1h_range_pctile.required_formula: percentile of the range (high-low) of the newest fully CLOSED 1H bucket at t0. REFERENCE: the SAME bucket-of-trade-day from each of the previous 252 eligible trade dates where that bucket exists and is complete. An overnight bucket is compared only with overnight buckets. If fewer than 252 prior dates carry that bucket, the event is INELIGIBLE.
htf_1h_range_pctile.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0
htf_1h_range_pctile.missingness_rule: every comparator timestamp is STRICTLY earlier than t0, enforced mechanically. No nearest-bucket substitution, no interpolation, no bucket from a short/holiday session standing in. If the same bucket does not exist on a date, that date provides no comparator.

htf_1h_vol_state.required_formula: percentile of sqrt(sum of squared 1H log returns over the 24 CLOSED 1H bars ending at t0). REFERENCE: same bucket-of-trade-day comparator as htf_1h_range_pctile - one value per prior eligible trade date at the SAME bucket, never an arbitrary end-of-day bucket.
htf_1h_vol_state.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0
htf_1h_vol_state.missingness_rule: every comparator timestamp is STRICTLY earlier than t0, enforced mechanically. No nearest-bucket substitution, no interpolation, no bucket from a short/holiday session standing in. If the same bucket does not exist on a date, that date provides no comparator.

REFERENCE = the corresponding 78-bar statistic ending at the SAME 5m bucket-of-trade-day on each of the preceding 252 eligible trade dates. Not end-of-day RV, not a neighbouring bucket.

vwap_slope_sigma_per_bar.missingness_rule: FEATURE MISSING / event ineligible for THIS feature when fewer than 12 completed bars since the VWAP anchor. Insufficient history is NOT a flat slope: zero means an observed flat slope, which is a different economic state. No adaptive shorter window.

wick_body_ratio.required_formula: sell-side: (min(o,c) - l) / max(|c-o|, PROXY_BODY_FLOOR_POINTS) ; buy-side: (h - max(o,c)) / same denominator
wick_body_ratio.availability: every event-time feature is evaluated at EVENT_CONFIRMATION_TIME (t0) = sweep bar open + 300s, using only bars whose close <= t0
